_comment: Bild-Bibliothek-Config für scripts/build-image-library.mjs (Umsetzungs-Brief §5). Datengetrieben: Marke editiert Looks/Prompts/Kombinationen ohne Code. Globale Bild-DNA (`style`) liegt über ALLEN Bildern, damit die Bibliothek aus einem Guss wirkt. Dateinamen exakt nach §3.1/§3.2, damit render-preview.js + die Auswahl-Nodes sie finden.
style: a real photograph with genuine depth, texture and detail — never a flat colour block or solid colour field, soft natural daylight with gentle shadows, cohesive cool ocean-toned palette (deep navy, teal, seafoam, pale sand and off-white), airy and calm with a refined editorial mood, fine film grain, vertical 4:5, no logo, no text, never harsh black, never neon
_hero_note: Hero Flat->Foto-Paare (img/hero/): das echte Stück zu jedem Flat. Ghost-Mannequin, FRONTAL und ZENTRIERT auf dunklem Studio-Grund (#0f1e2e) — deckungsgleich zur Flat-Silhouette, damit das Auflösen Flat->Foto sitzt. Subjekte/DNAs in hero-pairs.json. Trend vor Palette (kreative Prints, aktuelle Farben).
hero_style: professional ghost-mannequin product photograph, the garment worn on an invisible mannequin facing straight forward, centered and upright, full garment in frame, floating on a clean dark charcoal seamless studio background (deep #0f1e2e), soft even diffused studio lighting, crisp true-to-life fabric texture and detail, subtle contact shadow, premium editorial e-commerce quality, vertical 4:5, no person, no face, no hands, no logo, no text
_bg_note: Breitbild-Ambiente-Hintergründe (img/bg/) hinter den Erzähl-Sektionen. Dunkel, cineastisch, ruhig — viel Negativraum, damit weißer Text darüber lesbar bleibt, ohne schweren Scrim. Thematisch je Sektion gewählt. 3:2 Querformat.
bg_style: cinematic editorial background photograph, deep moody low-key lighting, predominantly dark midnight-navy with subtle teal and seafoam highlights, refined and premium, soft gradients, generous calm negative space in the upper area for text, fine film grain, wide landscape 3:2, no people, no logo, no text, never neon, never pure black

backgrounds.final: sculptural flowing dark fabric folds merging into a calm ocean surface, deep midnight navy and teal, soft cinematic side light, elegant and aspirational

_bg_light_note: Heller Pivot-Hintergrund (img/bg/): die EINE Sektion, in der die Erzählung vom Problem zur Hoffnung kippt (#alternative). Bewusst NICHT in die dunkle Ocean-Palette gezwungen — lichtdurchflutetes Tageslicht, zukunftsgewandt/positiv, passend zur Vision. Inhalt vor Farb-Grade (Anweisung des Nutzers). Oben luftiger Negativraum für weißen Text. 3:2 Querformat.
bg_light_style: bright airy editorial background photograph, soft luminous natural daylight pouring in, light and hopeful and forward-looking, pale off-white and light wood tones with gentle teal and seafoam ocean accents, refined and premium, generous calm bright negative space in the upper area for text, fine film grain, wide landscape 3:2, no people, no logo, no text, never neon, never dark, never moody

backgrounds_light.alternative: a sunlit Swiss tailor's atelier by tall windows — a clean worktable with neatly folded bolts of reclaimed fabric, shears and a sewing machine, soft morning daylight flooding the bright room, pale walls and light wood, calm and human and optimistic

_prob_note: Problem-Szenen (img/problem/): EHRLICHE Dokumentarmotive zum jeweiligen Missstand. Inhalt vor Farb-Grade — bewusst NICHT in die dunkle Ocean-Palette gezwungen, sondern echtes, helles Tageslicht (die Marke ist zukunftsgewandt/positiv, nicht düster). 4:5.
prob_style: documentary editorial photography, honest and true-to-life, bright natural daylight, crisp clear detail, realistic colours, photojournalistic depth of field, vertical 4:5, no logo, no text, no recognizable faces, candid not staged, not dark, not moody

problems.overproduction: endless rows of identical brand-new garments on industrial rolling racks stretching into the distance in a vast bright factory, overwhelming abundance
problems.unsold: a huge bright distribution warehouse stacked floor to ceiling with unsold clothing in cardboard boxes, long wide aisles receding
problems.waste: an enormous mountain of discarded colourful clothing and textiles in an open landscape under bright overcast daylight, vast stark scale
problems.human: close-up of a garment worker's hands guiding fabric through an industrial sewing machine on a busy production line, dignified, daylight

hero_template: Editorial fashion photograph of a {category}, {look}, single-garment focus on a ghost / invisible mannequin against a near-black seamless studio backdrop, no logo, no text, photorealistic, ultra-detailed fabric, cohesive cool color grade with fine film grain, vertical 4:5.

looks.techAvant: cool directional studio light with hard shadows, charcoal / black / steel with a cyan edge, matte technical recycled nylon, sharp and architectural, future-leaning

material_template: Macro close-up of {material} fabric, raking side light revealing weave and sheen, filling the frame, photorealistic, same cool grade and fine grain.

_context_note: Kontext-Kacheln sind GARMENT-FREI (Szenen/Texturen, keine Kleidungsstücke) — sie erscheinen in jeder Kategorie-Reise; ein fremdes Kleidungsstück (z. B. eine Jacke in der Hosen-Reise) würde als Auswahl missverstanden.
